name: Navajo Shopping Center
demographics: Navajo Shopping Center serves an affluent San Carlos community with a 3-mile trade area population of 125,185 residents and average household income of $132,736. The primary market consists of established families and professionals living in homes valued at approximately $906,927, representing upper-middle-class demographics. With a daytime population of 127,632, the center attracts both residential shoppers and working professionals seeking convenient grocery shopping, services, and dining options. The demographic profile skews toward educated, higher-income households who value quality retailers and neighborhood convenience in the San Diego-Carlsbad-San Marcos market.
description: Navajo Shopping Center is a dynamic neighborhood shopping destination located at 8650 Lake Murray Boulevard in the desirable San Carlos community of San Diego, California. This 102,227 square foot community center benefits from excellent accessibility with direct access to Interstate 8 and State Route 125, serving over 1.7 million annual visits from the surrounding affluent neighborhoods. The center is anchored by Albertsons supermarket and features a strong tenant mix including Sola Salon Studios, Dollar Tree, O'Reilly Auto Parts, and Einstein Bros Bagels, providing essential services and conveniences for the local community. With an average household income exceeding $132,000 within a three-mile radius and home values approaching $907,000, Navajo Shopping Center caters to an established, upper-middle-class customer base seeking quality retailers in a convenient neighborhood setting. The property is professionally managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT known for developing and operating thriving retail destinations across the United States.
summary: Navajo Shopping Center is a 102,227 square foot community shopping center in San Diego's San Carlos neighborhood, anchored by Albertsons and featuring convenient access to I-8 and SR 125. The center serves an affluent trade area with household incomes averaging $132,736 and attracts over 1.7 million annual visits.
